business_tagline: Guided trails, clear views, unforgettable days out.
hero_eyebrow: Walk farther. Feel closer. · Cape Town
hero_subtitle: Small-group guided hikes for curious people who want the story behind the view. Table Mountain, Lion's Head, and the Cape Peninsula with local guides.
directions: Meet at Kloof Corner parking area, Tafelberg Road, Cape Town
what_to_bring: Water, sun protection, a light snack, and your sense of adventure.
what_to_wear: Comfortable hiking shoes and weather-ready layers.
footer_line_one: Claire's Hiking — Table Mountain & Cape Peninsula
footer_line_two: Guided departures daily, weather permitting · Cape Town, South Africa

tours.name: Table Mountain Sunrise Hike
tours.description: A quiet early-morning ascent with city and ocean views, reaching the summit plateau as the first light breaks over False Bay.

tours.name: Lion's Head Sunset Walk
tours.description: A golden-hour guided climb finishing above the Atlantic Seaboard, with panoramic 360-degree sunset views of Camps Bay and the Twelve Apostles.

tours.name: Silvermine Fynbos Trail
tours.description: An easy-paced nature walk through indigenous fynbos, sandstone formations, and mountain reservoir pools with local botanical storytelling.

tours.name: Cape Point Coastal Hike
tours.description: A full-day coastal traverse with dramatic sheer sea cliffs, endemic wildlife, and a cliffside trail picnic above the Atlantic ocean.

tours.name: Kirstenbosch Morning Walk
tours.description: A relaxed guided walk through the botanical gardens, Boomslang canopy walkway, and shaded lower contour trails of Table Mountain.

reviews.quote: A brilliant guide and the best sunrise view in Cape Town. Watching the golden morning light break over the Atlantic from Table Mountain was unforgettable.
reviews.author: Nandi A.

reviews.quote: Relaxed pace, thoughtful stories, and beautiful fynbos. Claire knows every trail and flower on the mountain.
reviews.author: Peter M.

reviews.quote: Small groups, friendly atmosphere, and zero stress. The booking widget was super fast and seamless.
